name: SSH MCP Server
description: Enables AI coding agents to securely execute shell commands on remote SSH servers with granular per-host permission controls. Automatically discovers hosts from ~/.ssh/config and exposes dedicated tools for each allowed host to ensure proper authorization before remote execution.
